nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: Root React application component that renders the app's route tree and shared UI chrome.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Root component that mounts the router and global UI chrome for the entire application.

nodes.name: careerApi.ts
nodes.summary: Thin API client module exposing career-related endpoints via the shared HTTP client.

nodes.name: dashboardApi.ts
nodes.summary: API client module for fetching dashboard data (including mentor feedback) via the shared HTTP client.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting all domain-specific API client modules (auth, admin, career, roadmap, student, etc.) for consumption elsewhere in the app.

nodes.name: profileApi.ts
nodes.summary: API client module handling user profile operations such as avatar updates and profile data retrieval.

nodes.name: roadmapApi.ts
nodes.summary: API client module for fetching and managing learning roadmap data and recommendations.

nodes.name: skillApi.ts
nodes.summary: API client module for skill assessment endpoints used by the student skill evaluation flow.

nodes.name: studentApi.ts
nodes.summary: API client module covering student-specific operations such as feedback requests and review submissions.

nodes.name: userApi.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal API client module for general user account endpoints via the shared HTTP client.

nodes.name: appConfig.ts
nodes.summary: Application configuration constants defining the API base URL, host, and OAuth provider authorization URL builder.

nodes.name: AppRoutes.tsx
nodes.summary: Central route table declaring all application routes (public, guest-only, and role-protected) and wiring pages to their paths.

nodes.name: AppRoutes
nodes.summary: Declares the full application route tree, mapping URL paths to page components with guest and role-protected wrappers.

nodes.name: GuestRoute.tsx
nodes.summary: Route guard component that redirects authenticated users away from guest-only pages such as login and registration.

nodes.name: GuestRoute
nodes.summary: Guards a route so only unauthenticated users can access it, redirecting logged-in users elsewhere.

nodes.name: ProtectedRoute.tsx
nodes.summary: Route guard component that restricts access to authenticated users and enforces role-based access control.

nodes.name: ProtectedRoute
nodes.summary: Guards a route so only authenticated users with an allowed role can access it.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the router's AppRoutes, ProtectedRoute, and GuestRoute components.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level barrel file re-exporting shared feature and page components consumed throughout the frontend.

nodes.name: AuthCardLayout.tsx
nodes.summary: Layout component providing a centered card container used to wrap authentication-related forms.

nodes.name: AuthCardLayout
nodes.summary: Renders a centered card wrapper for authentication form content.

nodes.name: AuthLayout.tsx
nodes.summary: Layout component composing the split-screen authentication page shell, pairing a form area with an illustration panel.

nodes.name: AuthLayout
nodes.summary: Composes the two-panel authentication page layout, pairing form content with the AbstractIllustration panel.

nodes.name: AvatarUploadModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Modal component providing drag-and-drop and file-picker avatar upload with client-side validation and error feedback.

nodes.name: AvatarUploadModal
nodes.summary: Modal UI for uploading an avatar image via drag-and-drop or file picker, with type/size validation before upload.

nodes.name: BaseModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Generic reusable modal shell handling overlay, close behavior, and escape-key dismissal for other modal components.

nodes.name: BaseModal
nodes.summary: Generic modal shell rendering an overlay and content container, handling close-on-escape behavior.

nodes.name: ConfirmModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable confirmation dialog component supporting configurable labels and a danger/default visual variant, built on BaseModal.

nodes.name: ConfirmModal
nodes.summary: Renders a confirm/cancel dialog with configurable labels and a danger variant, built atop BaseModal.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the BaseModal and AvatarUploadModal components.

nodes.name: AvatarUpload.tsx
nodes.summary: Profile avatar upload widget handling file selection, upload progress, GSAP-driven animation, and syncing the new avatar into the auth context.

nodes.name: AvatarUpload
nodes.summary: Handles avatar image upload, progress state, GSAP hover/entry animations, and updates the authenticated user's avatar via context.

nodes.name: AbstractIllustration.tsx
nodes.summary: Decorative SVG-based illustration component rendering an animated node-and-line graphic used on authentication and marketing views.

nodes.name: AbstractIllustration
nodes.summary: Renders an animated SVG network illustration with hoverable nodes, varying by the current auth view (login/register/etc.).

nodes.name: Header.tsx
nodes.summary: Top navigation header component showing branding and user session controls, using the auth context for login state.

nodes.name: Header
nodes.summary: Renders the top navigation bar including the logo and session-aware user actions.

nodes.name: Logo.tsx
nodes.summary: Presentational logo component supporting icon-only and full variants for use across headers and layouts.

nodes.name: Logo
nodes.summary: Renders the application logo, optionally hiding the icon or text portion.

nodes.name: NotificationBell.tsx
nodes.summary: Notification bell dropdown and full-page notification center, including read/unread state, markdown stripping, and mentor feedback notifications.
nodes.languageNotes: Composes several private sub-components (NotifItem, NotifRow, NotifFullPage, NotifDetail) alongside the main NotificationBell within a single file.

nodes.name: NotifIcon
nodes.summary: Renders the icon associated with a notification type.

nodes.name: NotifItem
nodes.summary: Renders a single compact notification row within the dropdown preview list.

nodes.name: NotifEmpty
nodes.summary: Renders an empty-state placeholder shown when there are no notifications.

nodes.name: NotifRow
nodes.summary: Renders a full notification row with read/unread toggle and delete actions for the full-page notification view.

nodes.name: NotifFullPage
nodes.summary: Renders the full-page notification center with all/unread filtering, mark-all-read, and clear-all actions, portalled to the document body.

nodes.name: stripMarkdown
nodes.summary: Strips common Markdown syntax (code fences, links, headings, emphasis) from notification text for plain-text preview display.

nodes.name: NotifDetail
nodes.summary: Renders a modal-like detail view (via portal) for a single selected notification.

nodes.name: NotificationBell
nodes.summary: Top-level notification bell component managing fetch, read/unread state, dropdown/full-page toggling, and mentor feedback notification loading.

nodes.name: ProgressBar.tsx
nodes.summary: Global top-of-page loading progress bar plus a route-change variant that animates based on active request counts.

nodes.name: GlobalProgressBar
nodes.summary: Renders a top-of-page loading bar that animates based on the count of globally tracked active HTTP requests.

nodes.name: RouteProgressBar
nodes.summary: Route-change variant of the progress bar shown during page navigation transitions.

nodes.name: ProtectedRoute.tsx
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper re-exporting the app router's ProtectedRoute component for use within the ui components namespace.

nodes.name: UserHeaderActions.tsx
nodes.summary: Header dropdown component exposing user avatar, role badge, settings navigation, and logout action.

nodes.name: UserHeaderActions
nodes.summary: Renders the user avatar/role dropdown in the header with links to role-specific settings pages and a logout action.

nodes.name: chart.tsx
nodes.summary: Recharts wrapper providing themeable chart container, tooltip, and legend components driven by a shared chart config context.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a React context (ChartContext) plus a useChart hook to propagate per-series color/theme config to Recharts primitives.

nodes.name: useChart
nodes.summary: Custom hook that retrieves the current ChartContext, throwing if used outside a ChartContainer.

nodes.name: ChartStyle
nodes.summary: Injects a scoped <style> tag defining CSS custom properties for each series' theme-aware color based on chart config.

nodes.name: getPayloadConfigFromPayload
nodes.summary: Resolves the chart config entry matching a Recharts tooltip/legend payload item by key.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the shared UI component library (Logo, Header, NotificationBell, ProgressBar variants, DatePicker, Spinner, etc.).
